svg.title: California wine-growing study atlas
svg.desc: Orient the North Coast and Central Coast, with selected additional wine places from the wider California landscape. Approximate study locations, not appellation boundaries. Numbers refer to the study key; a shared number connects places in one grouped lesson. 1: Napa & Sonoma (CA). North of San Francisco Bay; Sonoma lies west of Napa. 2: Central Coast (CA). A long coastal wine region south of the Bay Area; the reference places show some of its internal range.
